# Chris Scarlat

> Chris Scarlat (Cristian-Alin Scarlat) has been designing brands since 1998. From Berlin he offers brand and digital product consulting: brand identities, digital products, apps and experiences for startups, fintech, music and culture. He runs the studio Simplifium UG in Berlin.

- Location: Berlin, Germany (works remotely worldwide)
- Disciplines: brand and digital product consulting, product design, brand identity and logo design, UX, creative direction, experience design
- Email: chris@scar.lat
- Phone: +49 170 595 8989
- LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/scarlat
- Book a call: https://calendar.scar.lat
